column4: dialect-gated: cmd/cleat-worker/a_signal_plugin_workflow_is_tenant_scoped_test.go's cleat#2209 regression test runs one function per dialect, same shape as a-plugin-start-workflow-is-tenant-scoped.tsv beside it. This job supplies PostgreSQL only (CLEAT_TEST_DB), so the SQL Server function skips while the two PostgreSQL ones (plain and sharded) run. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestSignalPluginWorkflow_ -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one.
